title: 2 days left to save up to $190: Join 1,000+ founders and investors at TechCrunch Founder Summit
description: 2 days left to lock in your spot at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 and save up to $190 before Early Bird rates expire on June 26 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Register here.
summary_cn: TechCrunch创始人峰会2026早鸟票仅剩2天截止，最多可节省190美元。该活动汇聚1000+创始人与投资者，是AI创业者获取行业洞察、建立人脉的重要平台。产品经理可借此了解前沿AI创业趋势、投资热点及生态合作机会。
